objective: Make Mazzy VPN Desktop and CLI independently autonomous while sharing one package-internal privileged engine.
decisions: Never use /tmp or tmpfs for Mazzy VPN builds, tests, logs or scratch data; use the project-local disk directory .mazzy/work via TMPDIR.
/usr/bin/mazzy-vpn and /usr/local/bin/mazzy-vpn are optional public CLI entry points, never systemd runtime dependencies.
Desktop readiness depends on the internal engine and typed local API, not on a public CLI executable.
Migration must not restart or disconnect an active VPN.
Strict acceptance removes public CLI entry points and proves Desktop status, profiles and lifecycle still work; CLI is separately tested without Desktop.
Mazzy Brain external-project memory stays under .mazzy and never stores VPN profile contents, credentials or private keys.
Boot recovery uses explicit test-recovery, awaiting-egress and awaiting-cleanup phases; ordinary mutations require ready while the managed executor has a narrow resume gate.
API rollback snapshots observe only Mazzy-managed interfaces/routes/DNS/IPv6 guard in canonical JSON; global host route/DNS/nft byte comparison is forbidden.
